basis: First version found six disclosed true pickups but eight duplicates. Settled version found five, one after force and one duplicate; no forced rows went into the noise envelope. This third method is a separate, frozen pre-replay design.
new_certificate: Track the inverse-model wrench stencil before geometric clearance; never fire until measured clearance is at least 3 mm. Require longitudinal force to explain more than lateral force, plateau/range headroom as before, and a signed source first established inside the original 35 mm band. An established source may finish confirming after the band, but a new one cannot start there. The reported weak load must remain supported; only bridge for the existing native route's minimum persistence, never blind-latch a fixed long alarm.
calibration: Unchanged disjoint 27 no-force height envelopes. No new fitted constants. No desired trajectory, schedule, injected force, true contact, scenario ID or true payload property as runtime features. Course-supplied nominal models already include the configured payload.
evaluation: All disclosed inputs, independent normals, pair/cross controls; no new protected case materialization until explicit historical eligibility.
